title: Minimum Steps to Make Two Strings Anagram
description: You are given two equal-length lowercase strings `s` and `t`. In one step you can choose any character in `t` and replace it with any other lowercase English letter. Return the minimum number of steps required to make `t` an anagram of `s`.
constraints: s and t consist of lowercase English letters.
hints: Compute the frequency difference freq_s[c] - freq_t[c] for each letter.
Every surplus occurrence in s that is missing from t must be filled by replacing an excess letter in t.

examples.explanation: Replace 'a' in "aba" with 'b' so it becomes "bab".
Five characters in "practice" must be replaced to match "leetcode" frequencies.
"anagram" and "mangaar" are already anagrams, so 0 steps are needed.
